source.title: Bully (original PlayStation 2 release)
source.engine: RenderWare-based proprietary game technology (exact build and interfaces to be researched)
source.license: proprietary; do not redistribute game code or assets
source.notes: Initial feasibility profile only. A PS2 disc image is not a native PSP port. Use legally obtained media and keep proprietary files out of this repository.

known_blockers: No verified source code for the original PS2 game
PS2 executable and binary assets are not directly compatible with PSP
Engine, rendering, animation, world streaming, scripting, audio and save systems require title-specific analysis
PSP CPU, GPU, RAM and storage budgets require profiling and substantial redesign
evidence: Public platform references identify the original PS2 version as using RenderWare
No local game files have been inventoried yet; this status is provisional

assets.notes: Determine formats only from authorised local media and documented research. Do not commit extracted proprietary assets.

acceptance_tests: PSP Forge smoke-test builds with PSPSDK
native EBOOT.PBP boots on physical PSP hardware
prototype renders a test scene at 480x272
performance profiling before any full-game scope claim
known_issues: This profile is a research plan, not evidence that a Bully port currently works
No full-game conversion from an ISO is supported
